scripts.build: tsc --project tsconfig.json && npm run build:development && tsc --project emulator/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test:boundaries && npm run test:emulator
scripts.test:boundaries: npm run build && node --test test/production-boundary.test.mjs test/development-boundary.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project development/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project emulator/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.emulator.json --project demo-duit --only auth,functions,firestore "npm run test:smoke"
scripts.emulators:start: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --config ../firebase.emulator.json --project demo-duit --only auth,functions,firestore
